static_bound_observations: 32-bit add and subtract use u64; 64-bit add and subtract use u128. Word-add totals are at most2^(b+1)-1; subtract condition chooses a nonnegative low-word expression.
Word products fit the double-width unsigned host type. Multiply-accumulate high arithmetic uses that wider type; its mathematical whole total is at most2^(2b)-1.
UInt128 split/join shifts are0,32,64,96 or0,64, all below128.
For N=4/2, multiplication indexes i+j span0..2N-2, final carry indexes i+N span N..2N-1, and fixed half slices both have length N.
Complete full structures are constructed before checked outcome selection. Only Err(10) occurs in the checked API source.
Source helpers are consumed: checked add/sub call typed bit components; checked multiply calls whole-word accumulate, which calls mul_wide and add_carry.
independent_oracle_separation: Only own declaration/contract/input metadata was shared; no populated independent expected values, oracle implementation or oracle outputs were read.
